title: The Jeunesse Musicales de France and government support for the arts
summary: He explains the French government-funded organization and complains that the U.S. does not send black artists abroad.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Can you remember....you were saying /a call to come back to Europe and...I think there was something called Jeunesse Musical...
Jeunesse Musical du France. Monsieur Levy was the...

Monsieur Levy booked it. Jacob, he was. The impresario. Now the Jeunesse Musical d.u France was an organization just like some of the organizations; it was underwritten by the French government. One of the things about most of those foreign countries, though, Dan, is that they put in money into the arts. Did you know that? Most of them do. And I can't say...well, perhaps they'd do it in America; and then again, maybe I have a right to have this beef, that if they're going to send opera and opera singers to Japan, and a classical conductor to China, then why the hell can't they send some blacks someplace to do something, or the government, in the name of the government, or representing the country.

Because jazz is an American thing. It's our black thing. You see? So then why can't...I think I have a legitimate beef. I think that, hell, somebody should phone me and say, "Hey, Sam, what do you think, and what can we do?" And I think that because when you go with an idea you get shut off. They shut you out, Dan. You don't have a chance. You know, I don't have a chance to present anything. I wish I knew what Billy Taylor did, or how he could do it. And I'm calling his name because I have a great respect for him and he's accomplished things. It's just that I don't know...maybe with all of my knowledge and vast experience and the love for the music, maybe I just don't know how to...maybe I'm not the one to do it. / It has to be done. But somebody should do it. It has to be done.
There's just a little more being done now than some years

ago. The government is putting a little money into the arts, but, as you say, it's not enough. It's not the right (unintelligible). The reason why I brought up this Jeunesse Musicale. I was told, or I read somewhere, that when they booked you was the first time they had ever booked a...
